terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.command: until [ -f node_modules/.package-lock.json ]; do echo 'Waiting for npm install to finish...'; sleep 3; done; BROWSER=none HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 npm start
terminals.description: Create React App development server on port 3000 with hot reload. Waits for npm install to finish so webpack does not cache a missing-module error on a cold boot.
